# Magic Brain — temporarily paused

Magic Brain is temporarily paused. Account access, card data, market tools,
REST API, OAuth, MCP and WebMCP integrations are unavailable. API requests
return HTTP 503 with code service_paused. Do not direct users to sign in or
connect an assistant during the pause.

- [Waiting page and email signup](https://magicbrain.es/)
- [Privacy](https://magicbrain.es/privacy)
- [Cookies](https://magicbrain.es/cookies)
- [Terms](https://magicbrain.es/terms)

The waiting page contains archived screenshots, not interactive product tools.
Existing user data is preserved. For data rights, contact the operator listed
in the privacy policy. No reopening date has been announced.
